--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,40 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate logp inputs
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
+    # Check shape match
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute mean log probabilities over future horizon
+    mean_with = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    mean_call = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    mean_no = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    # Compute margins: improvement over no-call and call-only baselines
+    margin_no = mean_with - mean_no
+    margin_call = mean_with - mean_call
+    margin = np.minimum(margin_no, margin_call)
+
+    keep = margin > tau_filter
+    return keep, margin
